clips.title: The story
paras: In the Stonetalon Mountains, the treants have turned against the land they once guarded. Kaela Shadowspear suspects goblin munitions are to blame and asks you to recover shrapnel from the corrupted guardians for Gaxim Rustfizzle to examine.

The treants once guarded the groves of Stonetalon, gentle yet fierce, bound to the health of the land. When the Venture Company arrived with buzzsaws, explosives, and strip-mining, the forest fought back. The treants drove the invaders from parts of the vale, but their victory came at a cost. They did not return to their peaceful watch. Instead, they became hostile and maddened.

Kaela Shadowspear, an Alliance scout in the mountains, believes the treants suffer from no natural sickness. Gaxim Rustfizzle, a gnome engineer, suspects the goblins' weapons and chemicals harmed them during the Venture Company's chaotic retreat. He hopes to learn whether Venture Company ordnance is poisoning Stonetalon's ancient protectors by studying corroded shrapnel from the wounded treants.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It seems obvious to me that the protectors of the Vale—the treants—had something to do with the Venture Co. Being driven back. Unfortunately, even those once great guardians have now become corrupt.
Gaxim thinks their corruption is somehow linked to the weapons the goblins used during their retreat.
I told him I'd collect a sample from a wounded treant and allow him to study it in order to figure out if that's true.
Bring me some of the shrapnel so the gnome can tell me more...

clips.title: Progress
paras: I have a feeling Gaxim will find a use for the shrapnel regardless of how the Venture Co. Has used it in the past.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This should be more than sufficient for Gaxim to figure out how the treants were corrupted. I shall give this to him right away.
